title: Assessing Language Models for Scientific Applications: Inertial Confinement Fusion as a Use Case
abstract: arXiv:2610.38024v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Advancing language models for specialized scientific applications requires evaluations of scientific fluency, physical reasoning, and quantitative analyses. Using inertial confinement fusion (ICF) as a test case, we have developed an expert-curated benchmark of 250 questions spanning qualitative reasoning, numerical calculation, symbolic derivation, and equation formulation. Responses have been evaluated using deterministic numerical and symbolic checks together with language-model judges. We compared a variety of out-of-the-box closed-source and open-source large language models with Prospero, a model specialized through combined domain-adaptive pretraining and supervised fine-tuning for ICF. We also conducted initial retrieval-assisted evaluations. Prospero improved its aggregate score by 10.7 percentage points over its base model, with gains across all question types. translated_title: 评估面向科学应用的语言模型：以惯性约束聚变为用例
translated_abstract: 推进面向专业科学应用的语言模型需要对其科学流畅度、物理推理和定量分析能力进行评估。我们以惯性约束聚变（ICF）作为测试用例，开发了一个由专家精心编制、包含250道题目的基准测试，涵盖定性推理、数值计算、符号推导和方程构建四种类型。模型回答通过确定性的数值与符号校验并结合语言模型评判器进行评估。我们将多种开箱即用的闭源和开源大型语言模型与Prospero进行了比较，Prospero是通过领域自适应预训练与有监督微调相结合的方式针对ICF进行专业化的模型。我们还开展了初步的检索辅助评估。结果显示，Prospero的总分较其基础模型提高了10.7个百分点，且在所有题型上均有提升。前沿模型获得了最高的总分，但关键的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究构建了一个针对惯性约束聚变领域的专家审核基准测试（250道题），并证明经领域自适应预训练与有监督微调的专用模型Prospero较其基础模型总分提升10.7个百分点，为评估语言模型的科学专业能力提供了范例。
en_tdlr: This study introduces an expert-curated 250-question benchmark for inertial confinement fusion and demonstrates that the domain-specialized model Prospero improves its aggregate score by 10.7 percentage points over its base model, providing a use case for assessing language models' scientific fluency and physical reasoning.
